data.one_liner: Flutter productivity tool to isolate and run UI widgets as standalone apps.
data.what_it_does: Stager allows developers to isolate portions of a Flutter app into self-contained 'Scenes'. It uses code generation to build a control panel app where you can test different UI states, dark mode, text scales, and custom environment controls.
use_when: You want to develop and test individual widgets or flows in isolation without navigating through the entire app.
You need to showcase various UI states (loading, empty, error, dark mode) to designers.
You want to reuse UI scenes inside widget tests.
avoid_when: You are building a tiny app where traditional navigation and full-app debugging is already fast enough.
You cannot use code generation in your project.
strengths: Greatly increases development velocity for complex UI components.
Built-in environment controls for dark mode, text scales, and custom properties.
Scenes can be easily reused in widget tests.
weaknesses: Requires running build_runner to generate Stager app entry points.
Adds boilerplate for setting up Scene subclasses.
data.setup_notes: Requires running build_runner to generate the Stager app entry points, and launching apps using the generated files with optional --dart-define parameters.
